SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-30-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO FEB-14-2023 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506 *FINAL CONTINUANCE*. PLAINTIFF TIM CHANG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY TRICIA PEARSE WILLIAMS, CLAIM ADJUSTER. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS FOR MANDARIN INTERPRETER AND WAS ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPRETER AIDONG NI (#301135). DEFENDANT SEEKING CONTINUANCE DUE TO ASSIGNED ADJUSTER IS ON MEDICAL LEAVE. COURT GRANTS CONTINUANCE AS *FINAL CONTINUANCE*. DEFENDANT WILL HAVE TO PRESENT AN ADJUSTER FAMILIAR WITH THE CASE AT THE NEXT COURT DATE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) NICHELLE D. FLENTROY, CLAIM ADJUSTER. FILED BY DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF TIM CHANG IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY NICHELLE FLENTROY, CLAIM ADJUSTER. DEFENDANT COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO INFORMS COURT CASE HAS BEEN SETTLED OUTSIDE COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
